title: Servicing Fee Schedule: Late Charges and Returned Payments — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Servicing Fee Schedule — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

Late charges, returned-payment fees, the certified-funds restriction and courtesy late-charge waivers on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract use the figures below.

### Figures common to every tier

| Item | Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+ |
|---|---|
| Company returned-payment fee (before the contract's state maximum) | $25.00 |
| Returned payments within the lookback that trigger the certified-funds restriction | 2 |
| Lookback window for counting returned payments | 12 calendar months |
| Length of a certified-funds-only restriction | 6 calendar months |
| Late-charge grace period after an installment due date | 10 calendar days |
| Late charge, as a percent of the unpaid portion of the installment | 5.0 percent |
| Company maximum late charge per installment (before the contract's state maximum) | $30.00 |
| Unpaid installment portion below which no late charge is assessed | $10.00 |

### Courtesy late-charge waivers by tier

| Tier | Courtesy waivers allowed in any 12 calendar months | Installments in a row without a late charge required |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 1 | 9 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 1 | 6 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 2 | 6 |

### Notes

- An allowance of 0 courtesy waivers means the tier receives no courtesy waivers, whatever its on-time history.
- The $25.00 and $30.00 figures are the company's own amounts; the contract's recorded state maximum can make the charge lower.
- Tier 1+ is the only tier allowed two courtesy waivers in any 12 calendar months; Tier 2 and Tier 1 are allowed one, after 9 and 6 installments in a row respectively.
